description: This file defines the interface for network-related operations in the lighttpd project, including read/write functions, error handling, and platform-specific considerations.

methods.name: li_network_error_quark
methods.description: Returns the GQuark for network errors, used for error domain identification.

methods.name: li_net_write
methods.description: Performs a write operation, automatically repeats after EINTR.

methods.name: li_net_read
methods.description: Performs a read operation, automatically repeats after EINTR.

methods.name: li_network_write
methods.description: Performs a network write operation with chunk queue support.

methods.name: li_network_read
methods.description: Performs a network read operation with chunk queue support.

methods.name: li_network_write_writev
methods.description: Performs a writev operation for memory chunks and buffered file reads/writes.

methods.name: li_network_write_sendfile
methods.description: Performs sendfile for files if USE_SENDFILE is enabled.

methods.name: li_network_backend_write
methods.description: Backend write operation using the network API.

methods.name: li_network_backend_writev
methods.description: Backend writev operation using the network API.
